description: Christmas Island Water Resources – Zone of high brackish-saline water infiltration is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. Water resources data for Christmas Island were assembled as part of ongoing groundwater investigations and monitoring undertaken on Christmas Island during the period from October 1996 to June 1999. The shapefile ‘hbrackishsaline. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Cities and Regional Development. Its tags are Christmas, IOT, groundwater, topographic, water. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2022-05-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
